Title: Fix simulation mode nil-pointer crash
Description: Server crashed on startup in simulate=true mode — client.Kite dereferenced when nil
Notes: Zerodha validation + instrument subscription guarded behind !simulate

Title: Add WS read deadlines + pong handlers to all four WS handlers
Description: Connections hung indefinitely with no timeout or stale connection detection

Title: Add ping ticker + write deadlines to all writePump implementations
Description: No heartbeat meant dead clients were never detected; writes had no timeout
Notes: Ping ticker 45s + write deadline 10s + close frame on channel close

Title: Fix heatmap broadcast — context cancellation + write deadlines + ping
Description: Blocking WriteJSON with no deadline and no shutdown path caused goroutine leak
Notes: Context cancel + write deadlines + ping ticker + background read drain goroutine

Title: Fix Redis pubsub reconnect connection leak in CandleGenerator
Description: Old pubsub not closed before reassigning on reconnect — connection accumulation
Notes: pubsub.Close() + nil before reassign. time.Sleep replaced with context-aware select.

Title: Replace Fatal calls in worker goroutines with Error+return
Description: zap.L().Fatal from background goroutines killed entire process on recoverable errors
Notes: Fatal in subscribeAndProcessRedis + startDBFlusher + candle subscribe all replaced

Title: Fix double-close panic on monitorStopCh
Description: ctx.Done branch and deferred close both closed the same channel

Title: Fix startDBFlusher Fatal on invalid config
Description: Fatal on zero flush interval killed process from goroutine
Notes: Now logs Error and defaults to 500ms

Title: Fix tick depth array access
Description: tick.Depth.Buy/Sell are fixed [5]DepthItem arrays — always 5 elements. Previous guard silently dropped valid ticks.

Title: Fix flaky TestRequestID_UniquePerRequest
Description: UnixNano collisions under rapid sequential requests caused non-deterministic test failure
Notes: Atomic counter suffix added — all 100 requests produce unique IDs
